33971-witching-hill.title: Witching Hill
33971-witching-hill.creator: Unknown
33971-witching-hill.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Framed and glazed in the great window, this was not a picture calculated to inspire a very young man; and yet there was little to distract a brooding eye from its raw grass-plots and crude red bricks and tiles; for one's chief duties were making out orders to view the still empty houses, hearing the complaints of established tenants, and keeping such an eye on painters and paperhangers as was compatible with "being on the spot if anybody called." An elderly or a delicate

arxiv-2104-08044.title: Holmes : An Efficient and Lightweight Semantic Based Anomalous Email Detector
arxiv-2104-08044.creator: Peilun Wu 1 and Hui Guo 4
arxiv-2104-08044.description: Abstract Email threat is a serious issue for enterprise security. The threat can be in various malicious forms, such as phishing, fraud, blackmail and malvertisement. The traditional anti-spam gateway often maintains a greylist to filter out unexpected emails based on suspicious vocabularies present in the email’s subject and contents.

arxiv-2108-08747.title: Printable, castable, nanocrystalline cellulose-epoxy composites exhibiting hierarchical nacre-like toughening
arxiv-2108-08747.creator: Abhinav Rao, Thibaut Divoux, Crystal E. Owens, A. John Hart
arxiv-2108-08747.description: Abstract Due to their exceptional mechanical and chemical properties and their natural abundance, cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) are promising building blocks of sustainable polymer composites. However, the rapid gelation of CNC dispersions has generally limited CNC-based composites to low CNC fractions, in which polymer remains the dominant phase.

arxiv-2204-05721.title: Macroscopic analysis of time dependent plasticity in Ti alloys Journal: Journal of Materials Science & Technology
arxiv-2204-05721.creator: Yi Xiong, Phani S. Karamched, Chi-Toan Nguyen, David M. Collins, Christopher M. Magazzeni, Edmund Tarleton, Angus J. Wilkinson
arxiv-2204-05721.description: Abstract Component failure due to cold dwell fatigue of titanium and its alloys is a long-standing problem which has significant safety and economic implications to the aviation industry. This can be addressed by understanding the governing mechanisms of time dependent plasticity behaviour of Ti at low temperatures.

arxiv-2207-04004.title: Pairwise and high-order dependencies in the cryptocurrency trading network
arxiv-2207-04004.creator: T. Scagliarini, G. Pappalardo, A.E. Biondo, A. Pluchino, A. Rapisarda, S. Stramaglia
arxiv-2207-04004.description: Abstract In this paper we analyse the effects of information flows in cryptocurrency markets. We first define a cryptocurrency trading network, i.e. the network made using cryptocurrencies as nodes and the Granger causality among their weekly log returns as links, later we analyse its evolution over time.

arxiv-2211-06876.title: Real circles tangent to 3 conics
arxiv-2211-06876.creator: Paul Breiding, Julia Lindberg, Wern Juin Gabriel Ong, Linus Sommer
arxiv-2211-06876.description: Abstract . In this paper we study circles tangent to conics. We show there are generically 184 184 complex circles tangent to three conics in the plane and we characterize the real discriminant of the corresponding polynomial system. We give an explicit example of 3 3 conics with 136 136 real circles tangent to them.

arxiv-2404-08931.title: Label-free Anomaly Detection in Aerial Agricultural Images with Masked Image Modeling
arxiv-2404-08931.creator: Sambal Shikhar, Anupam Sobti
arxiv-2404-08931.description: Abstract Detecting various types of stresses (nutritional, water, nitrogen, etc.) in agricultural fields is critical for farmers to ensure maximum productivity. However, stresses show up in different shapes and sizes across different crop types and varieties. Hence, this is posed as an anomaly detection task in agricultural images.

arxiv-2407-11062.title: EfficientQAT: Efficient Quantization-Aware Training for Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-11062.creator: Mengzhao Chen, Wenqi Shao, Peng Xu, Jiahao Wang, Peng Gao, Kaipeng Zhang, Ping Luo
arxiv-2407-11062.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are crucial in modern natural language processing and artificial intelligence. However, they face challenges in managing their significant memory requirements. Although quantization-aware training (QAT) offers a solution by reducing memory consumption through low-bit representations with minimal accuracy loss, it is impractical due to substantial training resources.

arxiv-2409-02781.title: Uncountable Hyperfiniteness and The Random Ratio Ergodic Theorem Thanks: The research was supported by ISF (grant No. 1180/22) and by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation (KAW 2021.0258).
arxiv-2409-02781.creator: Nachi Avraham-Re’em, George Peterzil
arxiv-2409-02781.description: Abstract . We show that the orbit equivalence relation of a free action of a locally compact group is hyperfinite (à la Connes–Feldman–Weiss) precisely when it is hypercompact . This implies an uncountable version of the Ornstein–Weiss Theorem and that every locally compact group admitting a hypercompact probability preserving free action is amenable.

arxiv-2409-09915.title: Forearm Ultrasound based Gesture Recognition on Edge
arxiv-2409-09915.creator: Keshav Bimbraw, Haichong K. Zhang, Bashima Islam
arxiv-2409-09915.description: Abstract Ultrasound imaging of the forearm has demonstrated significant potential for accurate hand gesture classification. Despite this progress, there has been limited focus on developing a stand-alone end- to-end gesture recognition system which makes it mobile, real-time and more user friendly.

arxiv-2504-08637.title: Direct dependencies between neurons explain activity
arxiv-2504-08637.creator: Christopher W. Lynn 1,2,3
arxiv-2504-08637.description: Abstract {affiliations} Department of Physics, Yale University, New Haven, CT 06520, USA Quantitative Biology Institute, Yale University, New Haven, CT 06520, USA Wu Tsai Institute, Yale University, New Haven, CT 06520, USA Abstract Our understanding of neural computation is founded on the assumption that neurons fire in response to a linear summation of inputs.

plos-pone-0004672.creator: Agata Kranjc, Federico W. Grillo, Juraj Rievaj et al.
plos-pone-0004672.description: PLOS ONE research article. Bestrophins are a recently discovered family of Cl − channels, for which no structural information is available. Some family members are activated by increased intracellular Ca 2+ concentration. Bestrophins feature a well conserved Asp-rich tract in their COOH terminus (Asp-rich

pmc-11314787.title: Exploring the Potential of a Smart Ring to Predict Postoperative Pain Outcomes in Orthopedic Surgery Patients
pmc-11314787.creator: Michael Morimoto, Ashraf Nawari, Rada Savic, Meir Marmor
pmc-11314787.description: Poor pain alleviation remains a problem following orthopedic surgery, leading to prolonged recovery time, increased morbidity, and prolonged opioid use after hospitalization. Wearable device data, collected during postsurgical recovery, may help ameliorate poor pain alleviation because a patient’s physiological state during the recovery process may be inferred from sensor data.

pmc-11439453.title: Neuroprotective Effects of Bexarotene and Icariin in a Diabetic Rat Model
pmc-11439453.creator: Dilek Agircan, Tugba Melike Parlak, Oznur Tufan, Muhammed Demircioglu, Burak Dik
pmc-11439453.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), a chronic metabolic disorder affecting over 400 million people globally, is increasingly recognized for its detrimental impact on the central nervous system. T2DM is linked to neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and vascular dementia.

pmc-11462466.title: A new pricing method for integrated energy systems based on geometric Brownian motions under the risk-neutral measure
pmc-11462466.creator: Jun Liu, Lihong Zhou, Hao Yu
pmc-11462466.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). An integrated energy system (IES) is a promising energy-saving technology. With the advancement of technology and deregulation of the energy market, numerous distributed energy systems (DESs) will be accessed in the IES with various trading modes in the future. This makes it even more challenging to evaluate the fair energy selling price of IES, which is of great concern to market regulators and participants. To address this issue, this study proposes a risk-neutral pricing method for IES based on geometric Brownian motions.

pmc-11859194.title: Sodium Oxybate-Induced secondary mania with psychotic symptoms: a case report and literature review
pmc-11859194.creator: C Cárdenes Moreno, S Yelmo-Cruz, I Pérez Sagaseta de Ilurdoz, J J Tascón-Cervera, G P González-Rodríguez, M Gallego-Restrepo
pmc-11859194.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionSodium oxybate, an effective treatment for narcolepsy-associated daytime sleepiness and cataplexy, has been extensively. Despite its therapeutic benefits, sodium oxybate is not without its risks, and adverse psychiatric effects have been documented. This case report highlights a rare manifestation of sodium oxybate-related secondary mania with psychotic symptoms in a patient with narcolepsy, emphasizing the importance of recognizing and managing such adverse events.

pmc-12413058.title: Cell surface polysaccharides in the gut microbiota: occurrence, structure and role
pmc-12413058.creator: Victor Laplanche, Immacolata Speciale, Cristina De Castro, Nathalie Juge
pmc-12413058.description: The gastrointestinal (GI) tract is colonized by trillions of microorganisms living in a symbiotic relationship with the host. Commensal bacteria in the gut engage in cross-talks with epithelial and immune cells through effector molecules secreted or attached to the cell surface.

pmc-12728992.title: Growth factor and cell content in Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Leukocyte- and Platelet-Rich Plasma (L-PRP), Platelet-Rich Fibrin (PRF) in patients with long bone defects from combat injuries
pmc-12728992.creator: Valeriia Husak, Olena Povelychenko, Valentyna Maltseva, Kostiantyn Romanenko, Petro Vorontsov, Roman Pazdnikov
pmc-12728992.description: BackgroundIn contemporary regenerative medicine, platelet concentrates (PCs) are actively used as a promising method to support the regenerative process. However, the lack of standardized preparation protocols and the selection of PC types limits their broad clinical implementation, particularly in patients with non-unions or bone defects.

pmc-13087623.title: The Potential of Bioinformatics in Revolutionizing Disease Diagnosis in Sub‐Saharan Africa: A Narrative Review
pmc-13087623.creator: Wilfred Ofosu, Fleischer C N Kotey, Alex Odoom, Onyansaniba K Ntim, Eric S Donkor
pmc-13087623.description: Background and AimDespite its role in healthcare delivery and accessibility, the potential of bioinformatics to transform disease diagnosis in SSA remains unknown. This narrative review aims to assess the current status of bioinformatics initiatives in SSA and evaluate the role of bioinformatics in transforming diagnosis of major diseases in the region.

pmc-13173003.title: 422 Development of a pediatric obesity treatment using a Sequential Multiple Assignment Randomized Trial (SMART) design
pmc-13173003.creator: Bethany Forseth, Joey Skelton, Megan Roberts, John Jakicic, Veronica Vabishchevich, Ann Davis
pmc-13173003.description: Objectives/Goals: Pediatric obesity is a public health issue. Many youths in lifestyle obesity treatments do not improve their weight. Sequential Multiple Assignment Randomized Trial (SMART) study designs can support slow responders (e.g., youth who do not initially lose weight). SMARTs have limited use in pediatric obesity and lack data-driven adaptive rules.

pmc-13503192.title: Assessment of depression and suicidal thoughts among female trail runners
pmc-13503192.creator: Carolyn Hill, Cécile Vigne, Patrick Basset, David Baud, Volker Scheer
pmc-13503192.description: This cross-sectional study aims to screen for depression and suicidal thoughts, as well as identify associated factors, among female trail runners. An online survey was used, collecting participants’ sociodemographic data, trail running habits, medical indicators, and screening for depression (using the PHQ-9) and suicidal thoughts (using Q9 of the PHQ-9). A total of 318 female trail runners answered the survey.

pmc-13660172.title: Targeting HASPIN-mediated H3T3 phosphorylation disrupts an epigenetic-kinesin axis to suppress colorectal cancer mitotic progression
pmc-13660172.creator: Tong Wu, Yaguang Zhang, Sicheng Liu, Chensong Zhang, Yang Zhang, Qiuye Luo, Dian Gao, Yang Meng, Yixin Jiang, Junhong Han
pmc-13660172.description: Chemoresistance remains a major barrier in colorectal cancer (CRC) therapy. Through epigenetic compound screening in patient-derived organoids (PDOs), we identified CX6258.HCl as a potent growth inhibitor. Treatment with CX6258.HCl significantly inhibited cell mitosis and induced apoptosis in CRC cell lines. Mechanistically, CX6258.HCl binds the D687 residue within HASPIN’s kinase domain, suppressing H3T3 phosphorylation (H3T3ph).
